comment: alice challenges bob to dots_and_boxes on the 3-box board, drawing first as p1. An edge is named by the dot at its left or top end, then h lying across or v lying down: a1h joins a1 and b1, a1v joins a1 and a2. Completing a box claims it and moves again. Every later move draws the mover's first legal edge, and bob wins 6 boxes to 3.
The views hold every edge undrawn and every box open; only alice, to move, is offered the 24 edges.
d1h names an edge of the larger boards, but runs off this one: an illegal_action.

body.message: d1h is off the board of 3 boxes a side

comment: An edge needs its h or v.

body.message: edge "b2" is not valid: The edge: the dot at its left or top end, its column's letter from a at the left and its row's number from 1 at the top, then h lying across or v lying down, e.g. b2h.

comment: An edge that completes no box passes the move.
An edge already drawn is an illegal_action.
bob closes box a1: the event lists it, his score is 1, and he moves again.
The rest of the game: each mover draws the first edge its view offers.
A later read of the finished game carries the final view, with no edge offered.
